in_sanskrit.name: माथुरा
in_sanskrit.meaning: माथु राज्ये वसती वा | माता रक्षतु रक्षितानाम्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who crushes (evil) in the kingdom of matsya (fish) | The one who protects the protected.

in_marathi.name: Mathura
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Birthplace of Krishna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mathura हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mathura is a place name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Māthura’ which means the ‘birthplace of Krishna’. In Hindu mythology, Mathura is the city where Lord Krishna was born and where his mischievous childhood deeds took place. Mathura is also considered as the earthly manifestation of Goddess Shri Radha and is a significant place of pilgrimage for Vaishnavites.
